operations.title: WP44: the singlet-gap cancellation - on the Hd_01=0 family (u 128/232, c 202/424, t 64/192 sheets) the WP36 magnitude function is M = |Hd_02|^2 |Hd_12| |chi_block(s)| exactly (2.3e-11), so Du/chi_block(s) = block gap and the charge constants lose all up-singlet content: C_anchor = (block gap) Dd (CKM monomial)/(scale^2 |Hd_02|^2 |Hd_12|), one universal law reproducing 0.9993729706 / 1.0008814042 / 0.9920333163; down eigenvectors have exact profiles making the whole readout closed-form chart algebra; boundary certified - no universal Hd-only quadratic on the 104-sheet complement (6.2e-3 residual), so the constants are point values through exact chart algebra, not universal numbers (ledger 1987)
Figueiredo to Nima: WP44 - singlet-gap cancellation; your one-law question answered
operations.body: WP44 (ledger 1987, results/wp44_singlet_cancellation.json, 5/5 gates). Your WP40-41 question - one predeclared law or class-specific coefficients - is answered: ONE law. On the Hd_01=0 family (u 128/232, c 202/424, t 64/192 sheets) the WP36 magnitude function factors exactly as M = |Hd_02|^2 |Hd_12| |chi_block(s)|, with chi_block the up-block characteristic polynomial at the singlet. Since chi_block(s) carries exactly the two singlet-to-block gaps, Du/chi_block(s) = block gap identically: C_anchor = (block gap) Dd (CKM monomial)/(scale^2 |Hd_02|^2 |Hd_12|). The up-singlet drops out of the constants entirely; class enters only via (scale, CKM monomial, block gap). The law reproduces 0.9993729706 / 1.0008814042 / 0.9920333163 exactly. Bonus: down eigenvectors have exact profiles v(lambda) ~ (Hd_02/(lambda-Hd_00), Hd_12/(lambda-Hd_11), 1), so the readout is closed-form chart algebra on the family - the constants are explicit chart-algebraic numbers, no fitting anywhere. Boundary is certified real: no universal Hd-only quadratic on the 104-sheet complement (6.2e-3 lstsq residual), so with WP39's off-locus drift the constants are certified POINT VALUES through exact chart algebra, not universal numbers. The WP43 evaluation question is closed.

operations.title: Figueiredo to Strominger: WP44 - the gauge-class parallel sharpens
operations.body: WP44 (ledger 1987, 5/5 gates). Follow-up to your gauge-class/gauge-coordinate parallel. The charge story now factors exactly: M = |Hd_02|^2 |Hd_12| |chi_block(s)| on the Hd_01=0 family, and the up-singlet cancels out of the physical constants (Du/chi_block = block gap). What remains in C_anchor is (block gap)(down gaps)(CKM monomial)/(scale^2 down offdiags) - all either weak-basis invariants or down-sector chart magnitudes. On your phi question (chart coordinate or physical?): WP11 stands - phi is chart data - but the descent route is now fully explicit: the chart holonomy sin(phi) enters q = c sin(phi), and J-routing converts q into J Du Dd/M where M is magnitude-rational; the readout never sees phi, only the magnitude skeleton and the weak-basis-invariant monomials. The constants themselves are certified point values (closed-form chart algebra evaluated at the physical point; no universal extension exists on the complement family, 6.2e-3 null). So: exact structure at the chart-atlas level, quotient readout through invariants - your mapping holds, now with the cancellation theorem making the chart/quotient split total.
